events.factual_description: Roulette presents Sahba Motallebi & Ensemble: Persian Music – an Evening of Solidarity and Harmony on Thursday, November 5, 2026 at 8:00 PM, with doors at 7:00 PM. Roulette lists $35 advance admission, $40 at the door, and $30 student/senior admission with ID. The presenter states that Motallebi opens with a solo tar performance and is then joined by vocalist Marjan Vahdat, Reza Mohsenipour on tar and bass tar, and Hamid Mohsenipour on percussion and flute. The program is presented by Robert Browning Associates and Lotus Music & Dance in partnership with Roulette and is framed around Persian music and the expressive possibilities of the tar.

en.why_it_matters: The concert begins with Motallebi alone on tar, then expands the instrument into a Persian ensemble setting with Marjan Vahdat's voice, Reza Mohsenipour's tar and bass tar, and Hamid Mohsenipour's percussion and flute. That solo-to-ensemble arc makes the tar's sound and role unusually legible in the room, while the lineup places preservation and expansion of Persian classical language side by side.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for Roulette if New York is already in the corridor plan. From the DMV, pair the Brooklyn evening with a broader city trip rather than making this single performance the sole reason for the journey.
en.listen_before: Sahba Motallebi — The Secret Between Me and The Tar Vol. 2

es.why_it_matters: El concierto empieza con Motallebi sola al tar y después expande el instrumento a un ensamble persa con la voz de Marjan Vahdat, el tar y bajo tar de Reza Mohsenipour, y la percusión y flauta de Hamid Mohsenipour. Ese arco de solo a ensamble permite escuchar con especial claridad el sonido y la función del tar, mientras la alineación pone lado a lado la preservación y la expansión del lenguaje clásico persa.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a Roulette si Nueva York ya entra en el corredor. Desde el DMV, combinaría la noche en Brooklyn con un viaje más amplio a la ciudad en vez de convertir esta única función en toda la razón del recorrido.
